# Nowra Pest Quotes

> Pest control in Nowra and nearby suburbs: termites, cockroaches, spiders, ants, rats and mice. Tell us the pest and get one free quote from a local operator.

Nowra Pest Quotes (nowrapestcontrol.com) is a free pest control referral service, not a pest control company. It is run by Raf Web Studio. Visitors fill in a two-step quote form (suburb, pest type, property type, then contact details) and the request goes to one licensed local pest management operator, who quotes, does the work and holds the licence the job needs.

- Service: pest control, termite inspection and treatment, and pre-purchase timber pest inspection quotes
- Area: Nowra, Shoalhaven City Council (NSW), including North Nowra, South Nowra, West Nowra, Bomaderry, Worrigee, Cambewarra, Terara, Berry, Shoalhaven Heads, Greenwell Point, Culburra Beach, Callala Bay, Huskisson, Vincentia, St Georges Basin, Sanctuary Point, Basin View, Erowal Bay, Sussex Inlet, Ulladulla
- Contact: the quote form on the homepage (no phone line, no payments taken)
- Prices: no price list; a local operator will quote for each job
- Licensing: In NSW, anyone who applies pesticides for a fee or reward needs a pest management technician licence from the NSW Environment Protection Authority (EPA). Termite and other timber pest treatments need a timber pest management technician licence. Licences are held by individual technicians and are listed on the EPA's public register.
